title: Station Meridian Rising Again
author: E. M. Marchetti
blurb: Jude Amberdale, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
